text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It was one day after the Satsuki Sho, 
with the Japan Derby right around the 
corner."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What's this... 'BNW Special Feature'? What 
does it mean?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... you mean Biwa Hayahide, Narita 
Taishin, and Winning Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hah. How simplistic.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin says that, but the look on 
her face... also seemed somewhat happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the running style shown at the 
Satsuki Sho, public opinion transformed 
completely. The era of the 'Top Two' was 
over, and all eyes were now fixed on the 
three-way showdown between 'BNW'!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best in the Japan Derby too!

Let's give it our all in the Japan Derby 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Can we wrap up the meeting now? 
...Alright, I'm heading out then.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: TAISHIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you... Ticket!! Can't you do something 
about that loud voice every single time!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry!! But I really, really have to!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No matter whaaat!! I want to have a 
practice race with youuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Swept up in Winning Ticket's sheer 
momentum, before I knew it, we had ended 
up at the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's menu was already finished, so I 
wanted Narita Taishin to rest without 
pushing herself, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You're overprotective. Worrying too much. 
I have at least enough stamina for one 
mock race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ticket is an idiot. ...Seriously, an 
overflowing idiot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Still, her passion for the Derby is 
undeniably the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Wouldn't it be worthwhile to see for 
ourselves how she runs "right now"?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin!! I'm ready—let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*clunk!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the mock race between Narita 
Taishin and Winning Ticket got 
underway...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The distance was 2400m on turf, just like 
the Japanese Derby. Winning Ticket was 
pushing the pace hard right from the 
start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running, which at times almost looked 
as if she were fighting for control—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the final straight, she literally 
"exploded."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like I'd let you...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin chases fiercely as well. 
The sharpness of her final kick is as 
terrifying as ever— no, it's even sharper 
than it was in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
200 meters left! Winning Ticket briefly 
ceded the lead to Narita Taishin, but—!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The Derby...! Derby, Derby, DERRRBYYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
First place in the Derby... is the ONE 
thing I will NEVER hand overrr!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The result—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line by a nose with a 
thrilling late surge was Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, wheeeze*... Taishiiin... 
thank you so muuuuch...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Thanking me right after beating 
me. ...Seriously, you're getting on my 
nerves.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I managed to win today, but...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The reason I became someone who could 
win... Was because I saw you run in the 
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taixin really is incredible! She's crazy 
strong! But that's exactly why!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
To achieve my dream of becoming a Derby 
Umamusume!! I realized I have to get 
strong enough to beat you!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
“Beat you,” “I'll definitely win”!! That's 
the exact mindset I train with!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. So, are you satisfied with 
winning today?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Not. Even. Clooooose!! It wasn't the 
actual Derby, and I barely made it as it 
was!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Besides, between now and the Derby, you're 
definitely going to get stronger than you 
are now!! Right!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH!! In that case, I'm gonna train 
way, way, way, way moooore!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: See ya, Taishiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
She's already running like that again... 
Man, does she have infinite stamina or 
what?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Did you get a good look at that? 
Ticket's current strength, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Alright, meeting again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I need to put together a routine that'll 
let me beat her, too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chasing and being chased, refining one 
another. The presence of a rival pursuing 
her dream head-on is having a positive 
effect on Narita Taishinâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's what I had thought.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH!! THE DEEEEEEEERBYYYYYYYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...A dream, huh.
